+# Frozen targeted-experiment closure — A contribution
+
+M1 passed the repaired real-NFL, full-teammate-context mutation fixture before its remaining 2026 fit. The usage-only player-state addition did not improve the retained actual-line control. M2 now has 84 newly joined early offers and 226 scored offers across Weeks 1–9. These add exact-product coverage on already observed games, not new football observations or original advance-issued selections.
+
+| Experiment / product | Own Over W–L | Own Under W–L | Combined W–L / decided / rate | Unavailable / unknown |
+|---|---:|---:|---|---|
+| M1 unchanged direct mean | 61–46 | 85–84 | 146–130 / 276 / 52.90% | 0 / 10 |
+| M1 same learner + state mean | 58–45 | 86–87 | 144–132 / 276 / 52.17% | 0 / 10 |
+| M1 structured allocation mean | 13–15 | 116–132 | 129–147 / 276 / 46.74% | 0 / 10 |
+| M2 P2 BIN / BB mean | 16–17 | 94–99 | 110–116 / 226 / 48.67% | 0 / 0 |
+| M2 C1 BIN / BB mean | 19–18 | 93–96 | 112–114 / 226 / 49.56% | 0 / 0 |
+| M2 C2 BIN / BB mean | 19–17 | 94–96 | 113–113 / 226 / 50.00% | 0 / 0 |
+| M2 C2 BIN law direction | 10–9 | 102–105 | 112–114 / 226 / 49.56% | 0 / 0 |
+| M2 C2 BB law direction | 9–9 | 102–106 | 111–115 / 226 / 49.12% | 0 / 0 |
+
+M1 has 286 eligible RB offers, 276 decided, 10 unknown, 91 games and supported W1–7 coverage. The structured law retains its adverse bias and losses. The strongest compatible retained A3 mean is 148/276. The same-learner mean loses two decisions to its own control; its paired game interval spans zero. Raw law direction changes 137/276 to 138/276, with 19 disagreements and an interval spanning zero; raw Brier worsens from 0.274861 to 0.275068. Tiny broad numerical improvements do not erase the offered-player loss. The best combined frozen new-arm selective result is 19/27, with one additional unresolved selection. Its unknown-outcome bound remains below 75%. A tiny descriptive side-only bucket is not a supported accuracy claim. New usage-only recipes: **CLOSE_RECIPE_NO_GAIN**. Authenticated personnel and signed-yardage extensions were not completed by this test.
+
+M2's frozen attempt law and conversion means are identical within each BIN/BB pair; only conditional conversion variance changes. Mean direction is identical throughout. C2 law loses one early decision; the other paired law records tie. Probability changes are retained separately: P2 raw Brier 0.276353→0.276325, C1 0.274070→0.274068, C2 0.274389→0.274387. The strongest fully available retained B FTN B2 lower-median/law control scores 122/226; Always-Over scores 115/226. Captured website points are partial source-specific references, not exact-incumbent or complete-selector parity. The tested conversion-variance increment remains **CLOSE_RECIPE_NO_GAIN**; broader opportunity/conversion mechanisms are not disproved.
+
+[Completed M1 results, all frozen selection views, probability quality and paired records](../../targeted-accuracy-w1w9-01/A/EXECUTED_M1_CHECKPOINT_V2.md). [M2 early-join report and all 45 procedures' weekly records](EXECUTED_B_M2_EARLY_JOIN_V1.md).
+
+
+## C M3 coverage checkpoint
+
+C's seven immutable source bodies and all 7,900 typed new-arm parameter rows were received during the saved-output attempt. Typed parameters, points and model bindings matched the retained full outputs before the Week 9 source-interface stop. C's current publication is [`e4efc40f1c8922cbc66ead629efe210328b55da3`](https://github.com/NickNicky19/NFL-forecasting-NGS-C/tree/e4efc40f1c8922cbc66ead629efe210328b55da3); its M3 handoff commitments remain unchanged from the frozen delivery.
+
+The reused native adapter initially expected rolling per-game assignments for Week 9, which actually uses one frozen pre-first-T90 snapshot. The source-only repair reuses that existing contract, preserves exact 142-CMP membership and CMP/ATT fingerprints, and keeps the explicit FIXED_PRE_FIRST_T90_SOURCE horizon. No quote clock, line, player or outcome was fabricated.
+
+The final attempt completed source admission and a durable proof, but stopped **before launching the scoring worker**: its remaining CPU could not cover the minimum >60-second child allocation plus the unchanged 120-second retention and 20-second reporting reserves. A later containment pass reverified original source ownership/CAS/read-only bindings and retired only byte-identical stage metadata already preserved in the immutable proof. Stage bytes are now zero; original failures and B grades remain intact.
+
+**No additional C grades or selections were produced.** Native C W2–3 results stay complete under their original versions; the requested additional W1/W4–9 cells remain RESOURCE_BLOCKED, not model losses or zero-selection weeks. Student-t tuning remains closed. NB remains research/shadow, without a demonstrated replacement claim. New full-panel B selector views also remain unexecuted; B's completed native W5–9 selection findings are preserved.
+
+| Product | W1 | W2 | W3 | W4 | W5 | W6 | W7 | W8 | W9 |
+|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
+| A usage-only M1 | Scored | Scored | Scored | Scored | Scored | Scored | Scored | Input gap | Input gap |
+| New B M2 raw products | 10 offers | 25 | 26 | 23 | 28 | 28 | 28 | 28 | 30 |
+| C M3 offered-line products | Join blocked | Original native scores | Original native scores | Join blocked | Join blocked | Join blocked | Join blocked | Join blocked | Join blocked |
+
+Every panel is partial within the league. Missing main/alternate status remains unclassified. Real retained offers with unverified quote clocks are statistical diagnostics, distinct from cutoff-authenticated pregame records, internal thresholds and numerical-only origins. No internal threshold fills any actual-offer cell. No new NFL game, original issued pick or forward O/U decision was added.
+
+## Resources, receipt and verification limits
+
+M1 closed at **1,489.681653 recorded cumulative CPU seconds / 1,800**: one remaining 2026 fit, no 2025 refit. The real-NFL full-context mutation/design/transform fixture passed before fitting. Original unmetered-tail and qualification limitations remain; this is not a complete measured total. Published M1 scorecards passed binary/hash/gzip/CSV readback.
+
+The separate join closed at **830.968258 recorded cumulative CPU seconds / 900**, including both failed data attempts, the relative-path launch failure, source preflight and containment. Retained growth is 744,619/1,572,864 bytes; old logical task consumption is 10,874,510/12,582,912 bytes. Original failures stay charged. Saved-output input-body GETs total 25; the final C attempt made none. Preparation's transient 203,350-byte uncompressed metadata proposal is disclosed; final retained scope is below its existing cap after lossless encoding. Qualification/launcher overhead is not represented as a complete measured total. No M1 allowance was transferred.
+
+The A-environment independent checker reproduced sealed B arithmetic and reviewed C's source-only repair; it did not authenticate historical vintages or reproduce peer fits. A actually retrieved the B/C commitments described here. C's [latest checkpoint](https://github.com/NickNicky19/NFL-forecasting-NGS-C/blob/e4efc40f1c8922cbc66ead629efe210328b55da3/reports/targeted-accuracy-w1w9-01/checkpoint-closure-01/README.md) still lists the old unfinished M1/pending M2 status. C must intake these new A publications; C/B admission of them is not assumed.
+
+Runtime: Python3.12.14, NumPy2.3.5, pandas2.2.3, PyArrow23.0.1, SciPy1.17.0, scikit-learn1.8.0, CatBoost1.2.10; single thread. Exact commands, trusted model/proof bindings and recovery receipts remain in the established owner-local records. Public aggregates do not grant private row/model access.
+
+## INFORMATION-SKILL-01: next A hypothesis
+
+**Personnel-conditioned RB allocation beyond usage-only M1** is A's next primary hypothesis. Offered-player losses and structured underallocation motivate it, without establishing a personnel-related cause. The new block must contain actual earlier roster/status/return/limitation observations, roles and teammate competition. It must preserve team volume, sparse-player fallback and the other-player bucket. Closest studies are M1 and the closed A2/A3 allocation recipes; renamed historical usage does not qualify.
+
+The controlled design will retain strong unchanged C0, the same learner plus one personnel block C1, and one relationship-aware R1 on those enriched inputs; R0 only where needed to isolate structure. No fit or scoring has begun. A later experiment requires a finite pre-score registration and usable historical source coverage. M1's remaining allowance is not reassigned.
+
+A retrieved C's existing [official roster/transaction qualification](https://github.com/NickNicky19/NFL-forecasting-NGS-C/blob/e4efc40f1c8922cbc66ead629efe210328b55da3/reports/wave-closure-next-valid-01/personnel/QUALIFICATION.json) and [persistence receipt](https://github.com/NickNicky19/NFL-forecasting-NGS-C/blob/e4efc40f1c8922cbc66ead629efe210328b55da3/reports/wave-closure-next-valid-01/personnel/GITHUB_PERSISTENCE.json): **164 displayed NE/DET player links**, all displayed status sections, 48 skill-role rows and 47 identity matches, observed November14 and persisted at `bebaaba9a4c12d45444cef6916bd896ccefb86c4` before the retained event cutoff. This supplies a concrete route beyond an injury subset.
+
+The receipt still lacks authenticated historical W1–9/training vintages and a complete event-effective eligibility contract; one skill identity and later status/elevation changes remain unresolved. The retained cutoff has passed; A issued no forecast and will not backdate one. Current pages cannot backfill that history. A reuses C's source route rather than collecting it again. Historical experiment status: **PLAUSIBLE_HYPOTHESIS / SOURCE_BLOCKED**, not disproved. B's expected pass-mix/conversion and C's deployment/adjusted-defense work remain with their existing owners.
+
+## Compact requirement mapping and twelve-category queue
+
+| Component | Implemented / reused / blocked / deferred |
+|---|---|
+| M1 actual full-context NFL fixture, retained 2025 state, remaining 2026 fit and frozen scoring | IMPLEMENTED; no retuning; new usage-only recipes closed with no gain |
+| M1 authenticated personnel and W8–9 inputs | SOURCE_BLOCKED; usage-only result does not complete these mechanisms |
+| M2 new exact-product early84 grades | IMPLEMENTED; old 142-row ordinal bridge remains limited to its original FTN contract |
+| M2 attempt law, conversion means and qualified parent information | REUSED; variance-only scope explicit; broader expected pass-mix test is separate |
+| M2 full nine-week selection extension | DEFERRED_RESOURCE; native W5–9 negative selections remain complete |
+| M3 frozen typed handoff and source repair | RECEIVED / SOURCE-ONLY REPAIR VERIFIED; no new fit or tuning |
+| M3 additional offered-line scoring | RESOURCE_BLOCKED; original native W2–3 scores preserved |
+| M3 true alignment/all-route information; M4 independent prices | SOURCE_BLOCKED; no invented proxies or quotes |
+
+| Category | This checkpoint / exact continuing scope |
+|---|---|
+| rush_att | Completed usage-only M1 W1–7; CLOSE_RECIPE_NO_GAIN. New personnel test blocked on authenticated history. |
+| rush_yd | Existing rushing evidence retained; no carry result transferred to signed gain. Separate owned gain/context task remains. |
+| pass_att | Frozen M2 attempt law reused; no new attempt-product upgrade established. B owns opportunity improvement. |
+| pass_cmp | New M2 226-offer W1–9 raw diagnostic complete; variance increment closed without direction gain. Frozen extended selections remain separate. |
+| rec | Original M3 W2–3 scores retained; additional W1/W4–9 join resource-blocked. NB research/shadow; no promotion. |
+| rec_yd | Original frozen Student-t/Leaf comparisons retained; extra offered-line scoring resource-blocked; tuning closed. |
+| pass_yd | Prior category evidence/delivery queue unchanged; no M1/M2/M3 success transferred. |
+| pass_td | Prior category evidence retained; Count A delivery continues with its registered producer/connection owner. |
+| pass_int | Corrected outcomes/zeros and prior records retained; no new M1/M2/M3 gain transferred. |
+| rush_rec_yd | Existing evidence and required-component protections retained; no inherited carry/receiving success. |
+| inherited anytime_td | Exact offered-side dependency remains; no invented Under/NO offer. |
+| nick-chart-ppr-v1 | Exact offer/label dependencies remain; no legacy fantasy substitution. |
+
+## Finite remaining actions and production boundary
+
+- **A, C saved-output join:** resume only the unchanged C-only scoring package from the preserved proof/typed outputs and compatible offer bindings. A separately approved cumulative join allowance is required; the remaining 69.031742 recorded seconds cannot cover its guarded minimum. A concrete proposal is **900→1,260 cumulative CPU seconds (+360 only)**, carrying all 830.968258 already spent, no fits/tuning/new sources, same memory/source/retention guards, and a durable C raw checkpoint before selectors. This is proposed, **not approved or executed**. No M1 allowance is available to it. Completion is new C own-side/probability/coverage records and the frozen selection views or a retained exact stop.
+- **B:** independently check the permitted new84 M2 grades and applicable saved bridge scope; A's internal independent check does not substitute for B-owner receipt.
+- **C:** intake M1 completion and M2 early grades from the immutable links, append actual admission scope in its existing common record, and preserve the explicit C resource gap. No peer repository is written by A.
+- **C personnel source owner / A rushing model owner:** continue the existing permitted future source route; A's historical personnel fit starts only with authenticated earlier configurations and a separate finite registration. Completion requires event-effective canonical teammate/status histories with clocks and denominators, not today's roster copied backward.
+- **Registered producers / website owner:** current capture, Count A, exact Top Picks and independently eligible older releases continue separately. This checkpoint produced no new current feed, prospective offered-line selection, website activation or served-value verification. No new M2/M3 primary selection activation is authorized here. Numerical, direction, probability and ranking qualification remain separate, including the exact-product five-week rule.
+
+Broad-board and selective 75/80/90 claims remain **TARGET_NOT_ESTABLISHED** for the new A recipes. The new 70–80 research aspiration does not create a threshold search or a release gate. Original predictions, losses, grade versions, source restrictions and production ownership remain intact.
